$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.

export.description: Host can emit an export bundle for the caller's tenant or workspace (portability.md).

import.description: Host can import an export bundle via `POST /import`. When `true`, `dryRun` MUST also be `true` (a no-write plan preview is mandatory).

kinds.description: Estate kinds this host can export/import.

dryRun.description: Import supports a no-write plan preview. MUST be true if `import` is true.
